summary: All four round-1 minor findings are addressed cleanly with no regressions. RememberMeCookieSerializer Javadoc now accurately describes DefaultCookieSerializer mechanics (no more 'Boot's auto-configured' misnomer). SecurityConfig uses AbstractHttpConfigurer::disable method references with the correct import, the SecurityContextRepository bean carries an explicit 'NOT wired into HttpSecurity' comment, and CsrfCookieMaterializer Javadoc uses 'lazy' instead of 'deferred'. The test fixes also tighten the webhook bypass assertion (added isLessThan(500) so a misconfigured controller can no longer silently pass) and dedupe the duplicate GET /health block via inline andExpect(cookie().exists(...)). All imports remain in use; no dead code introduced.
